title: Heartbeat (agent to router, binary frame HB, stream 0)
description: GPU and node facts, sent every heartbeat_interval_s (3 s until the configuration bundle says otherwise). The router answers every HB with HBACK. It stores the values as the node's current state, runs its busy/free state machine and learns the desktop VRAM baseline from them. No field is required: a missing block means the agent does not report it, and the router keeps its previous behaviour for that fact (for example no game detection). The current Go agent always sends ts and gpu_present, and the four GPU fields and sensors when it has a GPU. Receivers ignore unknown fields.

gpu_present.description: Whether the node has a GPU (ADR-0102). false: no GPU values follow and the router sizes models by main memory (the memory block). Absent (agents before 0.36.0): the router keeps what the facts said, and a node without the fact counts as having a GPU.

gpu_util_pct.description: GPU utilisation in percent. Absent without a GPU.

vram_total_mib.description: Total VRAM in MiB. Absent without a GPU.

vram_used_mib.description: Used VRAM in MiB, all processes (Windows reports no per-process VRAM; the router subtracts Ollama's models and the agent's children). Absent without a GPU.

vram_free_mib.description: Free VRAM in MiB. Absent without a GPU.

ts.description: Unix time in seconds when the agent built the heartbeat. Informational; the router uses its own receive time.

ollama_tls_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the agent's local TLS proxy certificate for a directly reachable node (tls_mode auto). Absent without such a proxy.

ollama_proc_mib.description: VRAM of the Ollama process in MiB. Read by the router; the current Go agent does not send it.

update.description: Progress of the latest agent update order. Absent when the agent has had no order since it started.

ollama_update.description: Progress of the latest Ollama update order. Absent when there was none.

ollama_version.description: Version of the local Ollama (/api/version, refreshed at most every 60 s). Absent when it did not answer.

children_vram_mib.description: VRAM in MiB per child kind of the agent, without Ollama, so the router does not count it as foreign load. Absent when no child holds VRAM.

routes.description: Health of the services behind configured tunnel routes (agent setting tunnel.routes), by route name. The router only sends a routed request (for example rerank) to a node whose route is up. Absent without routes.

standby_models.description: Models of the standby Ollama (tunnel.upstream_fallback); the router may switch to it for one of these. Absent without a standby Ollama.

sensors.description: Temperature, power, throttling and GPU-Z values. The router stores the block unchanged for the UI and Home Assistant. Each field is absent when the source cannot provide it; the whole block is absent without a GPU.

throttle_mask.description: NVML clock throttle reason bit mask.

gpuz.description: true: this sample has fresh GPU-Z values.

gpu_guard.description: State of the agent's GPU guard (power limit, high-load tier, warnings; ADR-0019). The router flags a problem next to the node state and acknowledges its policy in HBACK gpu_guard_ack.

state.description: off, unavailable, normal, high_load, throttled, recovery, or not_applicable on a node without a GPU (agent 0.36.0; reason no_gpu). Agents before 0.20.0 sent German values, which the router translates.

pin16_w.description: Power through the 16-pin connector in W.

pin16_v.description: Voltage at the 16-pin connector in V.

pin16_ref_v.description: Reference voltage for the connector check in V.

limit_w.description: Power limit the guard set, in W.

default_limit_w.description: Default power limit of the card in W.

target_w.description: Power limit the guard aims for, in W.

problem.description: true: the guard sees a problem the operator should look at.

reason.description: Fixed reason code for state or problem.

update_report.description: Progress of an update order. The router ignores a report without state.

state.description: Agent update: downloading, applied, failed. Ollama update: checking, downloading, extracting, ready (waits for ollama-swap), swapping, applied, failed.

message.description: Human-readable detail, for display only. Not a control signal.

kind.description: Fixed failure type of an agent update, empty for none: app_control (an application control policy blocked the new binary; the router retries later) or downgrade (the agent refused an older version). Always sent by agents since 0.19.1; absent in Ollama update reports.

game.description: A running game as a fact. With supported false (no game detection on this platform) the router ignores the block; an absent block or enabled false clears the node's game state.

supported.description: false: this platform does not detect games. Absent counts as true.

enabled.description: false: game detection is switched off on this node (agent setting game.enabled, ADR-0103); nothing is detected and the router clears the node's game state. Absent (agents before 0.36.0) counts as true; the Go agent always sends it.

via.description: How it was detected: path (by its folder) or name. Agents before 0.36.0 sent the German pfad for path; the router still accepts it and stores path.

since.description: Unix seconds since the agent first saw it.

folders.description: Game folders in the agent's index (0: nothing installed, nothing detected).

procs.description: Processes that count as the game.

gpu_dedicated_mib.description: Dedicated GPU memory of the game in MiB.

gpu_shared_mib.description: Shared (system) memory the GPU uses for the game in MiB.

gpu_pct.description: Highest GPU engine utilisation by the game in percent; absent on the first pass.

memory.description: Main memory as a fact; the router avoids cold loads under memory pressure. A value the platform does not have (commit on Linux) is absent.

route_health.description: Health of one routed service. Only up true counts as up; an unknown reason counts as unhealthy.

up.description: The service answered its health check.

reason.description: Why it is not up; empty when up.
